scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:web && npm run bootstrap:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check src tests migrations
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format src tests migrations
scripts.migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
scripts.check: npm run lint:web && npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:web && npm run lint:api && npm run test:api
